hooks.command: d="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/ricochet-rs/agent-instructions"; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; { [ -d "$d/.git" ] || git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none https://github.com/ricochet-rs/agent-instructions.git "$d"; } && sh "$d/scripts/bootstrap.sh" >/dev/null && printf 'The SessionStart hook synchronized the shared ricochet-rs checkout at %s to commit %s and loaded instructions/global.md below. Do not fetch it again in this session.\n\n' "$d" "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --short HEAD)" && cat "$d/instructions/global.md"
